popup.title: GSOPs 2.9 by CG Nomads
popup.content:
Thank you for installing GSOPs, Where Magic Meets Reality.

This update includes support for Houdini 21 (installer, precompiled binaries, and a node to toggle between Houdini native and GSOPs splat conventions). You can now customize the GSOPs configuration directory (see README for more information). We strongly recommend you pull the latest (if necessary) and run the gsops_installer.hip again.

GSOPs is trusted by professional artists and studios worldwide. While we're proud to keep the core experience open source, this is only possible thanks to contributions and commercial licensing.

Please enjoy!
